definitions: A short pole with a flat blade at one or both ends, used to propel a canoe or other small boat.
A short, broad oar, typically used in pairs.
A flat-bladed implement used for mixing, stirring, or beating.
A flat board used for spanking, especially as a form of corporal punishment.
A small, shallow implement used by children to play in water.
examples: He grabbed a paddle and pushed off.
The canoe was propelled by two paddles.
She used a paddle to mix the dough.
The headmaster kept a paddle in his office.
Children splashed with their paddles at the beach.
